name: smwgraphics-super-mario-bros-giant
title: Super Mario Bros. - Giant Version
description:
It would be outrageous if there wasn't any graphics from Super Mario Bros. for July 2014's C3 event, so I decided to take more inspiration from Giant Land and decided to double the size of SMB's tilesets. These graphics includes 4 separate palettes for certain themes.

SMB Giant Land 1.pal: Normal SMB Palettes
SMB Giant Land 2.pal: Cave Levels Palette
SMB Giant Land 3.pal: Night Time Palette
SMB Giant Land 4.pal: Snow/Castle Palette

Have fun!
